lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har a(n)mrit naam dehu piaare ||
lines.translation: O my Beloved Lord, Har, Har, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin oopar guramukh man maaniaa tin ke kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are pleased to be Gurmukh - the Lord completes their projects. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan deen bhae gur aagai tin ke dookh nivaare ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who become meek before the Guru-their pains are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi gur aagai gur kai sabad savaare ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship services to the Guru; they are embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai naam a(n)mrit ras rasanaa ras gaavahi ras beechaare ||
lines.translation: Within their hearts is the ambrosial essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they savor this essence, sing the praises of this essence, and contemplate this essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਓਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad a(n)mrit ras cheenhiaa oi paavahi mokh duaare ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are aware of this ambrosial essence; they find the Gate of Salvation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਅਚਲਾ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh achal achalaa mat jis driRataa naam adhaare ||
lines.translation: The True is the Primal Being, Unmoving and Unchanging. One who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord - his intellect becomes focused and steady.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis aagai jeeu devau apunaa hau satigur kai balihaare ||3||
lines.translation: I offer my soul to Him; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhram doojai bhaai laage a(n)tar agiaan gubaare ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are stuck in doubt and attached to duality; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daataa nadar na aavai naa uravaar na paare ||4||
lines.translation: They do not see the True Guru, the Giver; they are not on this shore, or the other. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarabe ghat ghat raviaa suaamee sarab kalaa kal dhaare ||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He is supremely Potent to exercise His Might.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan daas kahat hai kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||5||3||
lines.translation: Nanak, the slave of His slaves, says, please, be merciful and save me! ||5||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid kee aisee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: This is the way to work for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kare s sat kar maanahu guramukh naam rahahu liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever He does, accept that as true. As Gurmukh, remain lovingly absorbed in His Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid preet lagee at meethee avar visar sabh jaai ||
lines.translation: The Love of the Lord of the Universe seems supremely sweet. Everything else is forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin rahas bhaiaa man maaniaa jotee jot milaai ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, he is in ecstasy; his mind is pleased and appeased, and his light merges into the Light. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab gun gaai tab hee man tripatai saa(n)t vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, his mind is satisfied. Peace and tranquility come to abide within his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaal bhae tab paaiaa har charanee chit laai ||2||
lines.translation: When the Guru becomes merciful, the mortal finds the Lord; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat pragaas bhaee har dhiaaiaa giaan tat liv laai ||
lines.translation: The intellect is enlightened, meditating on the Lord. He remains lovingly attuned to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jot pragatee man maaniaa har sahaj samaadh lagaai ||3||
lines.translation: The Divine Light radiates forth deep within his being; his mind is pleased and appeased. He merges intuitively into Celestial Samaadhi. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai kapat nit kapat kamaavahi mukhahu har har sunaai ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with falsehood, continues to practice falsehood, even while he teaches and preaches about the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੂਟੈ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tuh kootai dukh khaai ||4||
lines.translation: Within him is the utter darkness of greed. He is thrashed like wheat, and suffers in pain. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab suprasa(n)n bhae prabh mere guramukh parachaa laai ||
lines.translation: When my God is totally pleased, the mortal tunes in and becomes Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan paaiaa naam japat sukh paai ||5||4||
lines.translation: Nanak has obtained the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, he has found peace. ||5||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man raam naam man maanee ||
lines.translation: My mind is pleased and appeased by the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai heearai satigur preet lagaaee man har har kathaa sukhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has implanted divine love within my heart. The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal hovahu jan oopar jan devahu akath kahaanee ||
lines.translation: Please be merciful to Your meek and humble servant; please bless Your humble servant with Your Unspoken Speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil har ras paaiaa har man tan meeth lagaanee ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found the sublime essence of the Lord. The Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai ra(n)g rate bairaagee jinh guramat naam pachhaanee ||
lines.translation: They alone are unattached, who are imbued with the Lord's Love; through the Guru's Teachings, they realize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: purakhai purakh miliaa sukh paaiaa sabh chookee aavan jaanee ||2||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Primal Being, one finds peace, and one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਣੀ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainee birahu dekhaa prabh suaamee rasanaa naam vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: With my eyes, I gaze lovingly upon God, my Lord and Master. I chant His Name with my tongue.
